text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx observed for service `api-gateway-eu-west` — sustained 502/504 spike, ~18% error rate over 2m. Pager triggered 2026-03-17T02:15:34Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apigw-5xx.md

alice_oncall: i'm on it, joining. moving coordination to this thread. starting triage now.

bob_sre: seeing a big fanout to upstreams — a lot of `502` and `504` from `legacy-models` and `service-embeddings`. kv cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 18% in eu-west. memcached tail latency spiking to 1.2s.

carol_prod: customer impact: multiple enterprise customers (acme, globex) reporting timeouts; support volume up. CS notified key accounts. no data corruption reports, just failed requests/timeouts. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/apigw/errors?region=eu-west

dave_support: sample user error: `502 Bad Gateway` visible in logs attached to ticket #SUP-9342. pasted a snippet in case it's helpful.

alice_oncall: quick mitigations to try: 1) enable circuit breaker on `/v1/generate` to fail fast to cached variant 2) reduce edge concurrency 3) traffic-shift some percent to eu-central fallback. applying CB and reducing concurrency now.

bob_sre: logs: `kvcache: eviction_error: connection reset by peer` repeatedly + backend slow responses. memcached nodes show `OOM?` and network retransmits. I'm going to restart memcached pods one at a time.

alice_oncall: executing: ```kubectl rollout restart sts/memcached-eu-west -n infra``` also applying edge rate-limit patch: ```curl -X POST https://router.local/patch -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","max_conns":150}'```

carol_prod: initiating traffic shift to eu-central 30% as a precaution: `redwood-router shift --from eu-west --to eu-central --percentage 30 --dry=false` monitoring canary. notifying downstream teams.

bob_sre: memcached rolling restart in progress — pods restarting gracefully. tailing logs: latency improving on restarted nodes. error rate dropped to ~6% but still above our 5% SLO.

alice_oncall: enabled edge backpressure (return 429 for overloaded upstream) and bumped gateway nodes +3 in eu-west autoscaling group. commands: ```edgectl set-backpressure --region eu-west --mode conservative``` and ```infractl scale gateway-eu-west +3```

dave_support: update posted to customers: CS has sent proactive note to top 5 impacted customers. message: "We're investigating elevated timeouts in EU, mitigation in progress; no data loss."

incident-bot: Reminder: auto-escalation in 15m if error rate > 5%.

bob_sre: after restarts + traffic shift + backpressure, error rate now 1.9% and p95 latency normalized. memcached root cause: network flapping between two AZs caused mass KV eviction and downstream overload. infra to verify NICs and networking policies.

carol_prod: verified customer-facing impact reduced to baseline. closing mitigation window after 10m observation.

alice_oncall: followups assigned: eng-infra -> replace affected memcached nodes and investigate network fabric; eng-runtime -> add circuit-breaker thresholds and fallback route for model fanout; product -> coordinate postmortem and customer comms. scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

dave_support: thanks all :white_check_mark: great coordination.

alice_oncall: closing incident channel after posting initial timeline and RCA notes. please add any missing artifacts to the ticket. :eyes:
